research_question: Do frozen bounded P127/P128 candidate predicates satisfy independently declared metamorphic invariants under novel record construction and single-field transformations?
independence_basis: No reuse of Notebook 23 held-out fixture rows or its expected-control matrix.
Novel seeds 719, 823, 947 and independently constructed payloads.
Expected outcomes derived from metamorphic relations and a separate declarative oracle, not source-relation case labels.
Input order is independently shuffled before a second replay.

metamorphic_relations.name: valid_baseline_acceptance
metamorphic_relations.expectation: A fully bound valid record is REPRESENTABLE and NON_COLLAPSED.

metamorphic_relations.name: witness_removal_localization
metamorphic_relations.expectation: Removing witness changes P127 to REJECT_WITNESS and leaves P128 unchanged.

metamorphic_relations.name: history_removal_localization
metamorphic_relations.expectation: Removing history changes P127 to REJECT_HISTORY and leaves P128 unchanged.

metamorphic_relations.name: type_mutation_localization
metamorphic_relations.expectation: Changing relation type changes P127 to REJECT_TYPE and leaves P128 unchanged.

metamorphic_relations.name: context_nontransport
metamorphic_relations.expectation: Changing source context changes P127 to REJECT_CONTEXT and P128 to REJECT_PROFILE.

metamorphic_relations.name: threshold_boundary_strictness
metamorphic_relations.expectation: Setting distinction equal to epsilon leaves P127 unchanged and changes P128 to REJECT_SUBTHRESHOLD.

metamorphic_relations.name: threshold_monotonicity
metamorphic_relations.expectation: For fixed valid bindings, distinction below/equal threshold rejects and above threshold admits.

metamorphic_relations.name: witness_enrichment_invariance
metamorphic_relations.expectation: Bare versus enriched complete witness does not alter classifications.

metamorphic_relations.name: history_extension_invariance
metamorphic_relations.expectation: Appending valid history entries does not alter classifications.

metamorphic_relations.name: irrelevant_payload_permutation_invariance
metamorphic_relations.expectation: Changing trace and payload tokens without changing required bindings does not alter classifications.
